_readme: Faith Works photo registry: the one place that says which photo appears where. IMAGES lists every photo once: src (the original in assets/images/, never edited), alt, optional crop [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the original, position (CSS object-position focal point), social (also make a 1200px JPG for link previews) and socialDefault names the site-wide link-preview photo. replaces (retired image paths that CMS records may still point at; the build serves this photo instead). PAGES lists, per page, the galleries and photo slots the page sources call with {{gallery:page.slot}}. layout is single (one photo), stack (a main photo with floating cards), mosaic (an asymmetric grid) or figures (captioned photos). Each item names an image id and may override its alt or position (focal point) for that slot; caption is optional. The Events gallery (homepage and Workshops masonry) is listed in src/data/events.json. After adding or changing an image run `python tools/images.py` (Pillow) to make its web versions in assets/images/web/, then `node tools/build.mjs`.
